Bytes, slices and a table of strings in the Rust backend

The Zig tests passed, but the Rust that t27c wrote for them was refused by rustc. Four small cases pin it: counting a byte in a text, a digit test, a slice parameter and a table of strings.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.
